in_latin.name: Sheila
in_latin.long_meaning: Sheila est nomen verum et sincerum quod origine a lingua Hibernica provenit. Nomen ita appellatum est quia femina vera et sincera est. In modern times, Sheila has become a popular given name across Christian cultures, representing a strong and positive personality trait.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sheila gained popularity among the English-speaking world in the 19th and 20th centuries. In literature, one of the most famous Sheilas is Sheila the She-Wolf from the novel "Evans of the Avenue" by Monica Dickens.
